import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svdvals
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(2)

def summary(x):
    return "min %.4g max %.4g mean %.4g std %.4g norm %.4g" % (
        x.min(), x.max(), x.mean(), x.std(), np.linalg.norm(x))

def product_stats(A, B):
    # Pure matrix analysis of A @ B; no network inputs or layer execution.
    qa, ra = np.linalg.qr(A, mode="reduced")
    qb, rb = np.linalg.qr(B.T, mode="reduced")
    s = svdvals(ra @ rb.T)
    ev = np.linalg.eigvals(B @ A)
    f2 = float(s @ s)
    stable_rank = f2 / max(float(s[0] ** 2), 1e-30)
    trace_ratio = float(ev.real.sum() / max(np.abs(ev).sum(), 1e-30))
    symmetry = float(np.trace((B @ A) @ (B @ A)) / max(f2, 1e-30))
    return (np.sqrt(f2), s[0], stable_rank, trace_ratio, symmetry,
            np.max(ev.real), np.min(ev.real))

print("All calculations below concern weights and their matrix products only.")
for l in range(4):
    print("\nLAYER", l)
    for name in ["ln1_w", "ln1_b", "ln2_w", "ln2_b"]:
        print(name, summary(W[f"{name}.{l}"]))
    for name in ["W_q", "W_k", "W_v", "W_o", "W_fc", "W_proj"]:
        a = W[f"{name}.{l}"].astype(np.float64)
        s = svdvals(a)
        print(name, "F=%.4f s[:8]=%s stable_rank=%.3f" %
              (np.linalg.norm(a), np.array2string(s[:8], precision=3),
               np.sum(s*s)/(s[0]*s[0])))
    print("head product: F, s1, stable_rank, trace/sum|eig|, symmetry, max_Re_eig, min_Re_eig")
    for j in range(6):
        sl = slice(j*64, (j+1)*64)
        Q = W[f"W_q.{l}"][sl].astype(np.float64)
        K = W[f"W_k.{l}"][sl].astype(np.float64)
        V = W[f"W_v.{l}"][sl].astype(np.float64)
        O = W[f"W_o.{l}"][:, sl].astype(np.float64)
        b = W[f"ln1_b.{l}"].astype(np.float64)
        g = W[f"ln1_w.{l}"].astype(np.float64)
        qk = product_stats((Q*g).T/8, K*g)
        ov = product_stats(O, V*g)
        print("L%dH%d QK %s OV %s bias_norms(q,k)=(%.3f,%.3f)" %
              (l, j, np.array2string(np.array(qk), precision=3),
               np.array2string(np.array(ov), precision=3),
               np.linalg.norm(Q@b), np.linalg.norm(K@b)))

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd, eigvals
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(2)
np.set_printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True, linewidth=180)

def cos(a,b):
    return np.sum(a*b)/(np.linalg.norm(a)*np.linalg.norm(b)+1e-30)

As, Bs, us, vs = [], [], [], []
for l in range(4):
    aa, bb, uu, vv = [], [], [], []
    g = W[f"ln1_w.{l}"].astype(float)
    b = W[f"ln1_b.{l}"].astype(float)
    print("\nLAYER",l)
    for j in range(6):
        s = slice(64*j,64*(j+1))
        Q = W[f"W_q.{l}"][s].astype(float)
        K = W[f"W_k.{l}"][s].astype(float)
        V = W[f"W_v.{l}"][s].astype(float)
        O = W[f"W_o.{l}"][:,s].astype(float)
        Qg, Kg, Vg = Q*g, K*g, V*g
        Qg -= Qg.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
        Kg -= Kg.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
        Vg -= Vg.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)
        A = Qg.T@Kg/8
        B = O@Vg
        # The affine query-bias/key-feature term is a weight-derived direction.
        key_linear = Kg.T@(Q@b)/8

        u,t,vh = svd(A,full_matrices=False)

        ev = eigvals(Kg@Qg.T/8)
        ev = ev[np.argsort(-np.abs(ev))]
        print("H%d QK_s[:8]=%s key_linear_norm=%.4f query_linear_norm=%.4f u.v=%.4f" %

        if l == 0:
            print("   QK_eig[:16]=",ev[:16])
            print("   key_linear alignment with right singular vector=%.4f" %
                  (key_linear@vh[0]/(np.linalg.norm(key_linear)+1e-30)))
    print("QK pairwise cosine:\n",np.array([[cos(a,c) for c in aa] for a in aa]))
    print("OV pairwise cosine:\n",np.array([[cos(a,c) for c in bb] for a in bb]))
    if l == 0:
        print("leading Q-direction cosine:\n",np.array(uu)@np.array(uu).T)
        print("leading K-direction cosine:\n",np.array(vv)@np.array(vv).T)
    As.append(aa); Bs.append(bb); us.append(uu); vs.append(vv)

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
from sklearn.metrics import silhouette_score
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(2)
np.set_printoptions(precision=3,suppress=True,linewidth=180)

def ctr(a): return a-a.mean(-1,keepdims=True)
V=W["W_v.0"][128:192].astype(float)
Q=W["W_q.0"][128:192].astype(float)
K=W["W_k.0"][128:192].astype(float)
print("Raw L0H2 V singular values:\n",np.linalg.svd(V,compute_uv=False))
print("Raw L0H2 Q singular values:\n",np.linalg.svd(Q,compute_uv=False))
print("Raw L0H2 K singular values:\n",np.linalg.svd(K,compute_uv=False))

# Cluster MLP input weight directions after projection onto weight-derived
# value-reading subspaces. These are not token vectors or activations.
fc=ctr(W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)*W["ln2_w.0"])
g=W["ln1_w.0"].astype(float)
for kind in ["raw_V", "scaled_V", "OV_read"]:
    if kind=="raw_V":
        _,s,vh=svd(V,full_matrices=False)
        basis=ctr(vh[:28]*g)
        basis=np.linalg.qr(basis.T)[0]
    elif kind=="scaled_V":
        _,s,vh=svd(ctr(V*g),full_matrices=False)
        basis=vh[:28].T
    else:
        ov=W["W_o.0"][:,128:192].astype(float)@ctr(V*g)
        _,s,vh=svd(ov,full_matrices=False)
        basis=vh[:28].T
    z=fc@basis
    norms=np.linalg.norm(z,axis=1)
    z=z/np.maximum(norms[:,None],1e-12)
    km=KMeans(n_clusters=28,n_init=20,random_state=0).fit(z)
    counts=np.bincount(km.labels_,minlength=28)
    coherence=np.linalg.norm(km.cluster_centers_,axis=1)
    ix=np.argsort(-counts)
    print("\n",kind,"mean projected norm fraction=%.3f"%
          np.mean(norms/np.linalg.norm(fc,axis=1)))
    print("silhouette=%.4f"%silhouette_score(z,km.labels_))
    print("cluster sizes:",counts[ix])
    print("cluster mean-direction norms:",coherence[ix])
    print("cluster size entropy=%.4f"%
          (-np.sum((counts/counts.sum())*np.log(counts/counts.sum()))))

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd, eigh
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

np.set_printoptions(precision=3,suppress=True,linewidth=180)

def ctr(a):
    return a-a.mean(-1,keepdims=True)
def invsqrt(a):
    e,u=eigh(a)
    return (u*(1/np.sqrt(np.maximum(e,1e-8*max(e.max(),1e-12)))))@u.T

q=ctr(W["W_q.0"][128:192].astype(float)*g)
k=ctr(W["W_k.0"][128:192].astype(float)*g)
A=q.T@k/8

print("L0H2 QK eigenvalue-energy / singular-value-energy:",
      np.sum(np.abs(np.linalg.eigvals(k@q.T/8))**2)/np.sum(A*A))
print("L0H2 QK traces of powers (normalized by spectral radius):")
radius=np.max(np.abs(np.linalg.eigvals(k@q.T/8)))
small=k@q.T/(8*radius)
power=np.eye(64)

    power=power@small
    print(i,round(float(np.trace(power)),4))

print("This is a correlation of coefficient matrices, not a bigram probability or a layer evaluation.")
_,_,vraw=svd(V,full_matrices=False)
_,_,veff=svd(ctr(V*g),full_matrices=False)

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
threadpool_limits(2)
np.set_printoptions(precision=4,suppress=True,linewidth=160)

def ctr(a): return a-a.mean(-1,keepdims=True)
As=[]; Bs=[]; cs=[]
for l in range(4):
    g=W[f"ln1_w.{l}"].astype(float)
    b=W[f"ln1_b.{l}"].astype(float)
    for j in range(6):
        s=slice(j*64,(j+1)*64)
        Q=W[f"W_q.{l}"][s].astype(float)
        K=W[f"W_k.{l}"][s].astype(float)
        V=W[f"W_v.{l}"][s].astype(float)

        q=ctr(Q*g); k=ctr(K*g); v=ctr(V*g)
        As.append(q.T@k/8)
        Bs.append(O@v)
        cs.append(k.T@(Q@b)/8)

common=np.mean([c/np.linalg.norm(c) for c in cs[6:12]],axis=0)
common/=np.linalg.norm(common)
u,s,vh=svd(Bs[5],full_matrices=False)

print("head |c| cos(c,common_L1) fraction_c_in_L0H5_top2_output")
for h,c in enumerate(cs):
    print("L%dH%d %.4f %.4f %.4f" %
          (h//6,h%6,np.linalg.norm(c),c@common/np.linalg.norm(c),
           np.linalg.norm(summary_space.T@c)**2/np.linalg.norm(c)**2))
